messages:
alex.k: Quick context — we need a concrete proposal for Dedicated -> Hosted spillover behavior and how model-variant fallbacks interact with tenant isolation. Draft below, looking for implementation concerns and telemetry we should surface.

maria_p: TL;DR?

alex.k: Two main goals: 1) keep Dedicated tenants insulated by default, 2) allow controlled spillover for soft-commit tiers when capacity is tight, with observable handshakes and aborts.

devon: Important to define what "insulated" means: no shared KV/cache, no cross-tenant KV leakage, and no change in SLA unless tenant opted in.

chao: +1. Also need to be explicit about network egress paths — Dedicated -> Hosted should not route via customer VPC. That causes audit concerns.

alex.k: Agreed. Proposal sketch:

```
policy: {
  tenant_type: [dedicated, reserved, soft_commit, hosted_free],
  spill_strategy: {
    dedicated: { allow_spill: false },
    reserved: { allow_spill: true, fallback_variants: [quantized-8, small-ctx], max_latency_increase_ms: 50 },
    soft_commit: { allow_spill: true, require_consent: true, telemetry_hook: 'spill_event' },
    hosted_free: { allow_spill: true }
  }
}
```

alex.k: Key points:
- Dedicated: default deny spill; explicit opt-in via contract + console flag.
- Reserved: allow controlled spill into hosted but only to verified variant families (same model name, lower perf variants).
- Soft_commit/PLG: can spill but surface a console banner and billing delta.

sre_tom: For telemetry we need: spill_count, spill_latency_delta_p50/p90, spill_fallback_rate, tenant_egress_path, and an alert when >X% requests spill for >Y minutes.

maria_p: UX: console should show per-tenant a "spill status" timeline and a toggle for "allow temporary spillover" with audit log. We should also expose a per-route override in API keys.

chao: What about model-variant regression risk? If we fallback to quantized-8 we may degrade quality. Need a prompt-based canary test before redirecting traffic.

devon: Suggestion: add an "auto-eval" hook. Before enabling fallback for a tenant, run n sample prompts from their pinned promptset against candidate variant and measure perplexity/metrics. If delta > threshold, block auto-fallback and require manual review.

alex.k: Love it. That means the runtime needs to support an eval hook that takes a prompt set and runs in the background. Could be async; we need safety timeout.

ops-bot: deploy:spill-policy 1934567890 initiated by alex.k — requires review from chao, maria_p, and sre_tom.

maria_p: Operational questions: how do we charge when spill happens? bill-on-hosted-rates or prorate reserved pricing? Need finance input.

devon: From infra POV we must ensure KV cache keys include tenant-id and runtime-variant-id. No cross-tenant cache reuse. Also want metrics: cache_hit_by_tenant_by_variant.

chao: Also add a handshake ACK between Dedicated ingress and Hosted pool: the Hosted node should return a short-lived tag proving it handled the request for audit. Store tag in request trace.

alex.k: Implementation plan (short):
- Phase 1: Server-side policy flags + telemetry (spill events, latency deltas).
- Phase 2: Console UX + per-tenant toggle + audit logs.
- Phase 3: Auto-eval canary + gating, billing decisions.

sre_tom: Rollout strategy: start with internal tenants + 2 low-risk customers. Feature flag everything. Add graceful circuit-breaker that reverts to original Dedicated queue if hosted latency > SLO for 2 minutes.

maria_p: UI copy: "Allow temporary spillover to hosted pools when Dedicated capacity is exceeded. Enabling may change latency/cost. Audit logs will be recorded." Add link to docs.

devon: One more: ensure we surface a clear metric in per-route dashboard: "percent served by fallback variants" so product teams know.

alex.k: Outstanding asks: chao — handshake tag format; devon — KV cache isolation checklist; maria_p — console mockups; sre_tom — alert thresholds. Meeting Friday to finalize?

chao: I can post handshake proto by EOD.

devon: I'll draft checklist.

maria_p: I'll do quick mock.

sre_tom: I'll propose thresholds: spike alert at >5% spill for 10min, elevated at >15% for 5min.

alex.k: Thanks all. If no objections, I'll open a PR with policy schema and telemetry proto tomorrow. :thumbsup:
